# Rectangle Health

> Rectangle Health provides integrated practice management, payment processing, patient engagement, and HIPAA compliance solutions for healthcare providers across multiple specialties.

Rectangle Health's core platform, Practice Management Bridge, combines payment processing (Bridge Payments), patient engagement (Bridge Engagement), and compliance management (Bridge Compliance) to streamline healthcare operations. The platform serves providers across dental, orthopedic, physical therapy, fertility, and eye care specialties, with integrations to major EHR/EMR systems and features like PayerSync for automated insurance reimbursements.

## Core Platform

- [Practice Management Bridge® - Rectangle Health](https://www.rectanglehealth.com/platform/practice-management-bridge): Core Practice Management Bridge platform overview with payments, compliance, and engagement.
- [Bridge™ Payments - Rectangle Health](https://www.rectanglehealth.com/platform/bridge-payments-and-financing): Bridge Payments product for healthcare payment processing and patient collections.
- [Patient Engagement Solutions | Rectangle Health Bridge Engagement](https://www.rectanglehealth.com/platform/bridge-patient-engagement): Bridge Engagement solution for patient scheduling, messaging, and retention.
- [HIPAA and OSHA Security & Compliance Healthcare Software](https://www.rectanglehealth.com/platform/bridge-compliance): Bridge Compliance product for HIPAA/OSHA compliance and data security.
- [Insurance reimbursements in a few clicks.](https://www.rectanglehealth.com/platform/features/payersync): PayerSync feature automating virtual payer payments and insurance reimbursements.
